request.style: English, male country voice, warm and storytelling, solo with acoustic guitar and piano, gentle fiddle, reflective mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Eight days passed and the doors were locked tight
The disciples gathered in the quiet night
Thomas stood among them, heart still afraid
Jesus came in and the peace he displayed

[Pre-Chorus]
He said to Thomas, take a look around
Put your finger in, feel where I was bound
Stop your doubting now, believe in my grace
My Lord and my God, Thomas said in that place

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who have not seen yet believed
Their hearts are open and their souls received
No need for sight to know the way it is
Faith is the treasure, the quiet wish

[Verse]
Many signs were done in their presence that day
Not all are written for us to say
But these are recorded so you might see
Jesus is the Christ, the Son who set us free

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who have not seen yet believed
Their hearts are open and their souls received
No need for sight to know the way it is
Faith is the treasure, the quiet wish

[Bridge]
Life in his name is the gift we hold
Faith is the story that must be told
Without the seeing, the heart still knows
The peace that flows from the love that glows

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who have not seen yet believed
Their hearts are open and their souls received
No need for sight to know the way it is
Faith is the treasure, the quiet wish

[Outro]
Blessed are those who have not seen yet believed
